title: Fillable PDF forms leave some controls static
symptom: with fillable_forms, controls in headers and footers export as page content, not fields, without a diagnostic; controls in rotated cells, vertical sections, turned or vertical text boxes, text boxes inside text boxes and tables inside text boxes export as page content too, with a diagnostic; an inline text box draws no text yet (#585)
workaround: move the control into the body, outside rotated cells, vertical sections and turned text boxes
